_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Megabytes of memory one workspace command or terminal may use across all the processes it starts; past it the command is stopped.
examples: let shell commands use 2 GB of memory
my cargo build gets stopped for memory
limit how much memory a terminal can take

settings.description: Processes and threads one workspace command or terminal may run at once; more are refused or the command is stopped.
examples: a build fails with cannot fork

settings.description: Seconds of CPU time one workspace command or terminal may use across all its processes, ended ones included; past it the command is stopped.
examples: give terminals an hour of CPU time
long builds get stopped for CPU time
cap how much processor a command can burn
